waivers.verdict: Add Sam Darnold right now, first-come-first-serve, $0 — he's Seattle's actual starting quarterback, unclaimed while he's hurt, and a bubble rival would happily grab him. Drop Mike Gesicki, who costs nothing to lose. Two handcuffs the denial check also flagged, Chris Rodriguez Jr. and Kendre Miller, don't clear the bar — pass on both.

lineup.verdict: Lineup's set, nothing changes today. Lamar Jackson's status flipped from Out to IR, confirming surgery and a return no sooner than Week 14 — it's news about a player already in my IR slot, not a lineup decision.

trades.verdict: Hold. Lamar Jackson's tag is now officially IR — surgery, no return before Week 14 — which only reinforces why Cousins stays off the table. A full re-scan of all 11 other rosters turns up nothing new.

inactives.verdict: Hold — all ten starters show clean as of this morning's sync (10:10am ET), and none of today's official inactive lists have posted yet. Nothing to flip right now.

actions.name: Sam Darnold
actions.value_note: He's Seattle's named starter, not a backup — Drew Lock is only playing because Darnold is hurt, so the projection model undersells him badly.
actions.why: Blocks annaf23 (rank 9, on the bubble) from a real starting QB for free; also covers my Week 13 SUPER_FLEX when Cousins is on bye.
